sections.heading: Type power
lines: Dive and Twister also count as Flying for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Aeroblast, Bleakwind Storm, Dive, Dragon Ascent, Dragon Darts, Esper Wing, Fairy Wind, Flying Press, Grav Apple, Icy Wind, Ominous Wind, Razor Wind, Silver Wind, Sky Uppercut, Steel Wing, Thunder, Thunder Shock, Thunderbolt, and Twister: 1.5× stronger.
Sandsear Storm, Springtide Storm, and Wildbolt Storm: 1.3× stronger.
Bulldoze, Dig, Earthquake, Magnitude, Rototiller, Spikes, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes: no effect here.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Flying-type.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Grav Apple, Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, and Thousand Arrows change the field into Mountain.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Big Pecks: Defense +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: This field sweeps away entry hazards.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Defense +1 and Special Defense +1.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
